name: currency-format
bug_class: currency unit mismatch (cents rendered as dollars)
real_breakage: GET /api/orders/42 renders total as $1999.00 — formatPrice() assumes a dollar amount while the data layer stores total_cents (1999 = $19.99)
green_tests: tests/format-price.test.mjs feeds the formatter invented dollar amounts, matching its assumption; the cents-based data layer never reaches it in tests
